📣 Sophia’s Bday Project 2025 Update 

We would like to officially announce the funds raised for this year’s Birthday Project.

Total Amount Raised: ₱72,591.75

Breakdown:
• ₱60,591.75 — Donations collected via GCash and PayPal
• ₱12,000 — Already paid for three (3) LED advertisements
  – EDSA Guadalupe
  – C5
  – NAIA

Fund Utilization:
The total amount raised will be utilized for the following:
• MOA Globe Advertisement
• Kids for Jesus Foundation

We sincerely thank everyone who donated, shared, and supported this project. Your trust and generosity truly mean everything to us. 💜

Further details and project updates will be shared soon.
